definitions.explanation: The practice or products aimed at making skin lighter, brighter, or more even-toned. A major category in the Japanese cosmetics industry.

examples.japanese: {美白|びはく}{化粧品|けしょうひん}を{使|つか}っている。
{美白|びはく}{効果|こうか}のある{成分|せいぶん}が{入|はい}っている。
examples.english: It contains ingredients with skin-whitening effects.

examples.japanese: {夏|なつ}は{日焼|ひや}け{止|ど}めを{塗|ぬ}って{美白|びはく}を{心|こころ}がけている。
examples.english: In summer, I apply sunscreen and try to maintain fair skin.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of {美|び} (beauty) and {白|はく} (white). Extremely common in the Japanese skincare and cosmetics industry. Products labeled {美白|びはく} include lotions, serums, and supplements that aim to brighten skin tone and reduce spots or uneven pigmentation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {美白|びはく}{化粧品|けしょうひん} (skin-brightening cosmetics)
- {美白|びはく}{効果|こうか} (skin-whitening effect)
- {美白|びはく}ケア (skin-brightening care)
- {美白|びはく}{美容液|びようえき} (brightening serum)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {美肌|びはだ}: beautiful skin — broader term for skin beauty
- {色白|いろじろ}: fair-skinned — describes natural skin color
